title: A batch gate builds the trial image from the commit it gates
description: A fixture repository whose base commit's graphyard.trial.Dockerfile does not build gets a tip that repairs it; the gate's changed files do not name the file. With a stub docker first on PATH, the real batch-gate trial of the tip builds the tip's own Dockerfile, runs the preMerge check 'gofake verify' in that image and passes, instead of building the parent's broken copy and reporting a trial-host fault.

steps.name: a batch gate of a tip repairing a broken trial Dockerfile verifies the tip
